newsitem.title: USA: Imex president, CFO Malachowski resigns.
newsitem.headline: Imex president, CFO Malachowski resigns.

text.p: Imex Medical Systems Inc said Friday that Ernie Malachowski, its president, chief financial officer and chief operating officer, has resigned to take a chief executive position with a Colorado law firm.
Imex said chairman and chief executive Dennis Newman has assumed the position of president.
The company did not name a successor to the position of chief financial officer, and no one at the office could be reached immediately.
The company said Malachowski will remain on its board.
Imex designs, makes and sells products for fetal heart detection and the early diagnosis of vascular disease.
